Fabric Philosophy

How to Measure

  • Chest — Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape horizontal.
  • Length — Measure from the highest point of the shoulder to the bottom hem.
  • Sleeve — Measure from the top of the shoulder to the wrist with arm slightly bent.

When in between sizes, we recommend sizing up for a relaxed fit or sizing down for a slim fit.

Help

Care Instructions

Proper care ensures your ALBION garments retain their shape, colour, and feel wash after wash. Follow these guidelines to get the most from your investment.

T-Shirts & Polos

  • Machine wash cold (30°C) with similar colours
  • Do not use bleach or fabric softeners
  • Tumble dry on low heat or air dry flat
  • Iron on medium heat — do not iron directly over prints

Hoodies & Sweatshirts

  • Machine wash cold inside out to preserve colour
  • Wash separately for the first 2–3 washes
  • Air dry only — tumble drying may cause shrinkage
  • Do not iron drawstrings or embellishments

Jackets & Outerwear

  • Spot clean with a damp cloth when possible
  • For full wash, use cold water on gentle cycle
  • Hang dry only — lay flat if garment is heavy
  • Store on broad-shouldered hangers to maintain shape
  • Do not dry clean unless label specifically recommends

General Tips

Turn all garments inside out before washing to minimise pilling and colour fade. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Fold heavy knits instead of hanging to prevent stretching.

Shipping & Returns

Shipping Policy

We ship across India via premium courier partners with real-time tracking. Orders are processed within 1–2 business days.

Shipping TypeEstimated TimeCost
Standard Delivery5–7 business days₹99
Express Delivery2–3 business days₹199
Free Delivery5–7 business daysFree on orders above ₹3,000

Returns & Exchanges

We offer a hassle-free 15-day return and exchange policy. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging with all tags attached.

  • Initiate a return within 15 days of delivery
  • Returns are free for defective or incorrect items
  • For size exchanges, a pickup and redeliver fee of ₹149 applies
  • Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to original payment method

How to Initiate a Return

  1. Log in to your account and navigate to "My Orders"
  2. Select the item(s) you wish to return
  3. Choose "Return" or "Exchange" and follow the prompts
  4. Print the prepaid return label (for eligible returns)
  5. Drop off at the nearest courier partner location

For any issues, contact our support team at support@albion.in or via the Contact Us page.

Brand

Our Story

"Albion" — the oldest name for Britain. A word that carries centuries of craft and character.

Founded in 2024 with a singular belief: that fine clothing should be made with intention, worn with pride, and passed down with meaning. Every Albion garment begins with the finest British-sourced wools and linens, cut and finished by craftspeople who understand that true luxury is measured in decades, not seasons.

We are not a fast fashion brand. We do not follow trends. We make things that last, for people who value what endures.

Our Mission

To craft garments that outlast trends, outlast seasons, and outlast the fast-fashion cycle. We believe great clothing should be an investment — in yourself, in your confidence, and in a more sustainable future.

Where We Are Today

100% British-sourced materials. Over 70 pieces in our growing catalog. And a guarantee on craftsmanship that lasts a lifetime.

Every stitch is still done with the same care as day one. That will never change.

Brand

Craftsmanship

At ALBION, craftsmanship is not a marketing term — it is the foundation of everything we do. We believe the difference between a good garment and a great one lies entirely in the details most people never notice.

Our Process

  • Fabric Selection — We source directly from certified mills, inspecting each bolt for consistency, weight, and feel
  • Pattern Making — Our in-house designers create patterns by hand, refined through dozens of fit tests
  • Cutting — All pieces are cut with precision to minimise waste and ensure consistent sizing
  • Stitching — A team of 30+ skilled tailors work on each garment, with every seam checked by a quality supervisor
  • Finishing — Every garment is pressed, inspected, and folded by hand before packaging

47 Quality Checks

Before any ALBION garment leaves our facility, it passes through 47 individual quality checkpoints. From thread tension to button alignment, nothing escapes our scrutiny. Only garments that pass every check earn the ALBION label.

Fade-Resistant Technology

All our dyed garments use a proprietary colour-lock process developed in partnership with our fabric suppliers. Your ALBION piece will retain its colour through hundreds of washes — guaranteed.
